name: Premium Minimalism
oneLiner: Warm near-white paper, one serif voice, hairline rules, and vast quiet space — luxury communicated by restraint instead of decoration.

motion.reducedMotion: cross-fade only; no translate or scale, and no image zoom on hover

primary.base: height: 52px; padding: 0 28px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accent-text); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: opacity 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1)

text.base: padding: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 0

hairline.base: padding: 40px; border-radius: 0; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); box-shadow: none

default.base: height: 48px; padding: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 1rem

bar.base: height: 76px; padding: 0 48px; background: var(--uiux-color-bg); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase
bar.scrolled: background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--uiux-color-bg) 92%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(8px)

default.header: text-align: left; padding: 0 0 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--uiux-color-text-muted)

default.base: height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); font-size: 0.625rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--uiux-color-text-muted)

do: Let one serif display voice carry the page; keep everything else in one neutral sans.
Use space as the primary hierarchy tool: at least 96px between major sections.
Draw structure with 1px hairline rules, not shadows or filled blocks.
Limit the palette to paper, ink, one muted neutral, and a single status color per message.
dont: Do not add gradients, glows, or glossy buttons; they read as mid-market.
Do not use more than two type sizes inside one card.
Do not center-align body copy; keep a strong left edge.
Do not use pure #FFFFFF paper for the page background — the warmth is the signal.
antiPatterns: Serif headline over a gradient hero with a glowing CTA — premium styling without premium restraint.
Six competing font sizes and three accent colors on one screen.
Cards with 24px radius and heavy shadows inside an otherwise flat layout.

notes: Warm near-white backgrounds compress perceived contrast; hold body text at 7:1 or better, not the 4.5:1 minimum.
Hairline borders are decorative: never rely on a 1px rule alone to delimit an interactive target.
Letter-spaced uppercase labels must still meet 4.5:1 at 11–12px.
